title.extracted:

desc.health.system: All health centres providing TB services (N=3) covering 4 administrative divisions
sampling.desc: Total sampling with allocation of sample size at each facility proportional to the TB notification
participant.screening: Interviews of patients' current costs; Interviews of patients' past costs
study.pop.desc:
eligible patients are patients registered for TB treatment (regardless of age, and of whether they
are affected by drug-susceptible or DR-TB) who are attending a sampled facility and who are at least
14 days into the present intensive or continuation
phase of their treatment
study.exclusion: Treatment less than 14 days; Drug resistant TB; Other: treated in facilities not reported to public health authorities or national tb program
participants.enrolled: during intensive phase of TB treatment; during continuation phase of TB treatment
care.cascade: Symptoms/care prior to diagnosis; TB diagnosis; Intensive TB treatment; Continuation TB treatment
delay.desc: greater than four weeks between symptoms and diagnosis; only among those in intensive tx phase
catastrophic.desc: costs greater than 20% of household income or expenditure
additional.comments: only able to extract summary from WHO report
study.quality.research.question: Yes
